senses.gloss: शक् (I) vi. 5P (pp. शक्त; pres. शक्नोति; desid. शिक्षति) 1. To be able, to be able to effect, to be competent for, (generally with an inf.), अंतःसारं घन तुलयितुं नानिलः शक्ष्यति त्वाम् Megh.i.20, Bt.iii.6; 2. to bear, to endure; 3. to be powerful.
शक् (II) vt. 4U (pp. शक्त; pres. शक्यति-ते) 1. To be able, to be competent for; 2. to endure, to bear.
शक (I) m. pl. The name of a country and its people, M.x.44.

शक (II) m. 1. Name of a king, (commonly applied to Śālivāhana); (the whole question about the word and its real import is yet unsettled); 2. an epoch, an era, (especially that of Śālivāhana which began 78 years after Christ).
शाक (I) m.n. A vegetable, a pot-herb, any edibie leaf or root used as a vegetable, अन्यैर्नृपालैः परिदीयमानं शाकाय वा स्याल्लवणाय वा स्यात् Jag., Yaj.i.182.
शाक (II) m. 1. Power, strength; 2. name of a people; 3. an era, especially the era of Śālivāhana; 4. the śirīshā tree; 5. the teak tree.
शक-अंतक, -अरि m. an epithet of king Vikramāditya who is supposed to have subdued the Śakas.
शक-अंतक, -अरि m. an epithet of king Vikramāditya who is supposed to have subdued the Śakas.
शक्कर m. A bull.
शक्करी f. 1. A girdle, a zone; 2. a woman of impure caste.
शाकारी f. The Prākṛt dialect spoken by the Śakāra (as in the Mricchakaṭikā).
शक-अब्द m. a year of the Śaka era.
शक-कर्तृ m. the founder of an era.
शकट (I) m.n. A carriage, a waggon, M.v.117.
शकट (II) m. 1. A form of military array resembling a wedge, M.vii.187; 2. a measure of capacity equal to two thousand Paṇas; 3. a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa in his infancy.
शाकट m. 1. A draught-ox; 2. the śleshmātaka tree.
सकट a. (f. टी) Bad, vile.
शकट-अरि, -हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
शकट-अरि, -हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
शकट-आह्वा f. the asterism Rohiṇī.
शकटिका f. 1. A small cart (as in मृच्छकटिका); 2. a toy-cart.
शाकटिक a. (f. की) Travelling by a cart.
शकन् n. Animal-dung.(This word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some, this is not a separate word but a substitute for शकृत्.)
शकल (I) m.n. A part, a portion, a fragment, a piece, अथांधकारं गिरिगह्वराणां दंष्ट्रामयूखैः शकलानि कुर्वन् R.ii.46, v.73.
शकल (II) m. 1. Bark; 2. the scales of a fish.
शाकल m. pl. The followers of the Śākala school of the Ṛgveda.
सकल a. (f. ला) 1. Together with a part; 2. all, whole, entire, complete; 3. with all the digits, full (as the moon), e.g. सकलेंदुमुखी; 4. having a soft or low sound.
सकल a. (f. ला) 1. Together with a part; 2. all, whole, entire, complete; 3. with all the digits, full (as the moon), e.g. सकलेंदुमुखी; 4. having a soft or low sound.
सकाल a. (f. ला) Seasonable.(सकालम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘seasonably, betimes, early in the morning.’)
सकाल a. (f. ला) Seasonable.(सकालम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘seasonably, betimes, early in the morning.’)
शकलित a. (f. ता) Reduced to fragments.
शकलित a. (f. ता) Reduced to fragments.
शकलिन् m. A fish.

शकार m. The brother of a king’s concubine, the brother-in-law of a king by a wife not regularly married; (the S.D. thus describes him- मदमूर्खताभिमानी दुष्कुलतैश्वर्यसंयुक्तः । सोऽयमनूढाभ्राता राज्ञः श्यालः शकार उद्दिष्टः). In the Mricchakaṭikā, where a principal part is assigned to this character, he is represented as a foolish, blundering, frivolous, proud, and cruel man.
शक्कर m. A bull.
शाक्कर m. An ox.
शकुन (I) n. A prognostic or omen foreboding good or evil, Sis.ix.83.
शकुन (II) m. 1. A bird in general, गोघ्रातं शकुनोच्छिष्टम् Yaj.i.168; 2. a vulture.
शाकुन a. (f. नी) 1. Relating to omens; 2. relating to birds, Yaj.i.158.
शकुन-ज्ञ a. knowing omens.
शकुन-ज्ञान n. knowledge of omens.
शकुन-शास्त्र n. science of omens.
शकुनि m. 1. A bird, M.v.11; 2. a vulture; 3. name of a maternal uncle of Duryodhana. (See App. II.)
शकुनी f. A hen-sparrow.
शाकुन a. (f. नी) 1. Relating to omens; 2. relating to birds, Yaj.i.158.
शकुनि-ईश्वर m. an epithet of Garuḍa.
शकुनि-प्रपा f. a trough for watering birds.
शकुनि-वाद m. 1. the sound of a bird; 2. the crowing of a cock.
शकुंत m. 1. A bird in general, असंख्यापि शकुंतनीडनिचितं बिभ्रज्जटामंडलम् Sak.vii.; 2. the blue jay.
शकुंतक m. A bird, कलमविकलं रत्युत्कंठाः क्वणम्तु शकुंतयः Ut.iii.
शकुंतक m. A bird, कलमविकलं रत्युत्कंठाः क्वणम्तु शकुंतयः Ut.iii.
शकुंतिका f. 1. a kind of bird; 2. a locust.
शकुल m. (fem. ˚ली) A kind of fish.
सकुल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Belonging to noble family; 2. belonging to the same family.
सकुल (II) m. 1. A kinsman; 2. a kind of fish.
सकुल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Belonging to noble family; 2. belonging to the same family.
शकुल-अर्भक m. a sort of fish.
शकृत् n. (शकन् is the base of this word in some cases) Excrement, ordure.
सकृत् (I) ind. 1. Once, सकृत्कन्या प्रदीयेत M.xi.92; 2. former, सकृत्कृतप्रणयोऽयं जनः Sak.v.
सकृत् (II) f. Ordure, feces. Cf. शकृत्.
शकृत्-करि m.f. a calf.
शकृत्-करी f. a calf.
शकृत्-पिंड, -पिंडक m. a lump or ball of dung, शष्पाण्यत्ति प्रकिरति शकृत्पिंडकानाम्रमात्रान् Ut.iv.
शकृत्-पिंड, -पिंडक m. a lump or ball of dung, शष्पाण्यत्ति प्रकिरति शकृत्पिंडकानाम्रमात्रान् Ut.iv.
शकृत्-द्वार n. the anus.

शक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Able, capable, competent, तस्योपकारे शक्तस्त्वं किं जीवन् किमुतान्यथा Ve.iii.; 2. strong, powerful; 3. opulent, rich, M.xi.9; 4. significant, expressive (as a word); 5. speaking agreeably; 6. clever, diligent, (pp. of शक् q.v.).

शक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Able, capable, competent, तस्योपकारे शक्तस्त्वं किं जीवन् किमुतान्यथा Ve.iii.; 2. strong, powerful; 3. opulent, rich, M.xi.9; 4. significant, expressive (as a word); 5. speaking agreeably; 6. clever, diligent, (pp. of शक् q.v.).
शाक्त (I) a. (f. क्ती) Relating to Śakti or the female representation of divine energy.
शाक्त (II) m. A worshipper of Śakti (the Śāktas are generally the worshippers of Durgā, the ritual enjoined to them is of two kinds, viz., वामाचार and दक्षिणाचार).
सक्त a. (f. क्ता) Devoted, attached to, बालस्तावत्क्रीडासक्तः M.Mud.11.
सक्त a. (f. क्ता) Devoted, attached to, बालस्तावत्क्रीडासक्तः M.Mud.11.

शक्ति f. 1. Ability, power, strength, energy, prowess, ज्ञाने मौनं क्षमा शक्तौ R.ii.22, ii.34, xi.42; 2. regal power (in politics); [it is of three kinds, viz., (1) प्रभावशक्ति or प्रभुशक्ति (the eminent position of the king); (2) मंत्रशक्ति (the power of good counsel); (3) उत्साहशक्ति (energy)], त्रिसाधना शक्तिरिवार्थमक्षयम् R.iii.13, Sis.ii.26; 3. a female deity; (these are variously enumerated); 4. a kind of missile, ततो बिभेद पौलस्त्यः शक्त्या वक्षसि लक्ष्मणम् R.xii.77; 5. the expressive power of a word, (op. to लक्षणा and व्यंजना) (in rhetoric), the relation of a word to the thing designated by it (in Nyāya); 6. the poetic faculty, poetic genius, शक्तिर्निपुणता लोकशास्त्रकाव्याद्यवेक्षणात् K.Pr.i.; 7. the inherent power of a cause to produce its effects (in Nyāya phil.); 8. the female organ worshipped by the Śāktas.
शाक्त (I) a. (f. क्ती) Relating to Śakti or the female representation of divine energy.
सक्ति f. 1. Contact; 2. junction, सक्तिं जवादपनयन्यनिलो लतानाम् Kir.v.46; 3. addiction to, attachment.
शक्ति-अर्ध n. perspiring and panting with exertion.
शक्ति-ग्रह m. 1. apprehending the meaning or acceptation of a word; 2. a spearman; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. of Kārtikeya.
शक्ति-ग्राहक m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
शक्ति-तस् ind. to the best of one’s ability.
शक्ति-त्रय n. the three constituents of regal power. (See (2) above.)
शक्ति-धर (I) a. developed, strong, powerful.
शक्ति-धर (II) m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
शक्ति-पाणि, -भृत् m. 1. a spearman; 2. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
शक्ति-पाणि, -भृत् m. 1. a spearman; 2. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
शक्ति-पात m. prostration of strength.
शक्ति-पूजा f. the worship of शक्ति.
शक्ति-वैकल्य n. deficiency of power, incapability, debility.
शक्ति-हेतिक m. a lancer, a spearman.
शक्न(क्ल) a. (f. क्ना) Speaking agreeably.
शक्न(क्ल) a. (f. क्ना) Speaking agreeably.

शक्य a. (f. क्या) 1. Possible, capable, practicable, capable of being effected (generally with an inf.), शक्योऽस्य मन्युर्भवता विनेतुम् R.xi.49, 54, Bg.vi.36; 2. fit to be effected or accomplished; 3. directly expressed (as the meaning of a word).(शक्यम् is sometimes used adverbially with a noun in any gender, and an inf., e.g. शक्यमरविंदसुरभि … अविरलमालिंगितुं पवनः Sak.iii., न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः Bg.xviii.11.)

शक्र m. 1. A name of Indra, R.i.75, iii.39; 2. the kuṭaja tree; 3. an owl; 4. the number ‘14.’
शक्र-अशन m. the kuṭaja tree.
शक्र-आख्य m. an owl.

शक्र-पर्याय m. the Kuṭaja tree.
शक्र-पादप m. 1. the Kuṭaja tree; 2. the Devadāru tree.

शक्र-सारथि m. Mātali, the charioteer of Indra.

साक्तुक (I) m. Barley.
साक्तुक (II) n. A quantity of fried grain.
साक्षात् ind. 1. In the presence of, before the eyes of, manifestly, visibly; 2. actually, in person, मृगानुसारिणं साक्षात्पश्यामीव पिनाकिनम् Sak.i., R.ii.16; 3. directly (as op. to परंपरया).
साक्षात्-कार m. 1. causing to be visibly present; 2. making evident to the senses; 3. intuitive perception, actual feeling.
साक्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Being a witness, witnessing, seeing; 2. attesting.
साक्षिन् (II) m. A witness, an observer, साक्षी लोकस्य पावकः K.S.v.60.
साक्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Being a witness, witnessing, seeing; 2. attesting.
साक्ष्य n. 1. Evidence, M.viii.82; 2. giving evidence, testimony, attestation.
